title.fr: Champ magnétique créé par un courant

formula: Fil rectiligne infini: B = μ₀·I / (2π·r) ;  Solénoïde: B = μ₀·n·I
sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with a mode toggle: (a) straight wire, (b)
circular loop, (c) solenoid. Each mode exposes a current slider I
(A) and a geometric slider (distance r for wire; radius R for loop;
length ℓ + turns N for solenoid). Canvas2D overlay renders field
lines: concentric circles around straight wire; loops through center
of coil; near-uniform axial field inside solenoid. Draggable test
point shows local B arrow and |B| readout using B = μ₀I/(2πr) or
μ₀NI/ℓ. Right-hand rule visualized as a hand icon. Experiment:
given target |B|, pick I and geometry. Evaluate: overlay hidden —
student picks I and r/R/N so |B| at the marked point matches.
Wrinkle: μ₀ = 4π·10⁻⁷ baked in; currents in A, distances in cm.
